REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis_and_Culture

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Appearance Reddish, WBC 10-20 /HPF, RBC Too numerous to count, Nitrites Negative, Leukocyte Esterase Positive. Culture: Not performed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The urinalysis shows significant inflammation with white blood cells and positive leukocyte esterase, but negative nitrites, which is unusual for a typical bacterial UTI. Do you have any fever or chills, and have you noticed any discharge or pain during urination?

REQUEST TEST: CT_Kidney_Ureter_Bladder

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Intravenous Pyelogram: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction noted.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The imaging showing multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts is highly specific. This finding, combined with your history of recurrent urinary tract infections and hematuria, points to Medullary Sponge Kidney.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney
